title: Natalia Cigliuti Signed 8x10 Photo Framed Lindsay Saved by the Bell New Class
descriptionText:
Natalia Cigliuti - "Lindsay Warner" on Saved by the Bell: The New Class - hand-signed black-and-white 8x10 promotional photo (the classroom chalkboard portrait), signed in black marker and inscribed "Lindsay." Displayed in a black wood frame with gold trim, about 10 x 12 inches overall. The back of the frame carries the original 1997 masking-tape label: "Natalia Cigliuti - Saved by the Bell - 1997."

Obtained in person in 1997. No COA - please judge the signature from the close-up photos.

Condition: Photo is clean under glass. Frame shows age - scuffing to the wood, worn corners, and the backing board is stained and marked (see photos). Sold as pictured. Please review all photos - they are of the actual item you will receive.
